firm_note.text: Arbor Wealth Management is a Tempe/Phoenix, AZ RIA founded in 2012, offering financial planning, investment management, and tax strategy for individuals and business owners; partners with Capital Review Group for tax strategy work.

Jake Clifford Ulrich.bio_note: Managing Partner and Chief Compliance Officer at Arbor. Studied at Arizona State University, then spent over a decade in banking across multiple sectors, including managing multiple bank branch locations, before co-founding Arbor in 2012. Long-time community volunteer with the Boys and Girls Clubs — involved since 2006, now on the Executive Board of Directors for the Boys and Girls Clubs of Arizona (Phoenix & East Valley).

Joseph Christopher Arsenault.bio_note: Managing Partner (Co-Founder) at Arbor, a licensed CPA and Personal Financial Specialist (PFS). Graduate of Arizona State University with a background in financial accounting, taxation, and retirement planning. Registered to provide investment advice in Arizona, Texas, and Utah; about 13 years in the industry.
Joseph Christopher Arsenault.bio_source: U.S. News financial advisor profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/joseph-arsenault-6126101), corroborating arborfirm.com/who-we-are/

Jordan Isaac Taylor.bio_note: Partner at Arbor focused exclusively on tax strategy. Previously built and led his own tax and accounting firm with offices in both Phoenix and Seattle before selling it. Brings deep knowledge of IRS code to client planning, with a particular focus on strategies for business owners; works in tandem with Capital Review Group.
Jordan Isaac Taylor.bio_source: arborfirm.com/who-we-are/ (firm bio page) — no independent corroboration of the tax-firm background found despite search; a LinkedIn profile was located but not independently verified

James Jason Merck.bio_note: No bio found. Appears in SEC ADV filings as an indirect owner (via the Jason Merck Revocable Trust) with the firm since 09/2016, but no bio, background, or career narrative could be located on Arbor's website or via independent web search — searches surfaced only unrelated individuals of similar name.
James Jason Merck.bio_source: None found — genuine search effort made (arborfirm.com team page, web search) turned up no matching independent source

Dan Joseph Melillo.bio_note: No bio found. Appears in SEC ADV filings as an indirect owner (via the DJM Revocable Trust) with the firm since 11/2019, but no bio, background, or career narrative could be located on Arbor's website or via independent web search.
Dan Joseph Melillo.bio_source: None found — genuine search effort made (arborfirm.com team page, web search) turned up no matching independent source

firm_note.text: Key Group Management is a Fountain Hills, AZ-based RIA founded in 1996 by Villanova University graduates Patrick Murray and Colin Heafy, managing ~$304M with offices in Arizona, New Jersey, and Massachusetts, specializing in holistic wealth management, insurance, and estate planning for high-net-worth clients.
firm_note.source: PR Newswire, Royal Alliance Associates release (prnewswire.com/news-releases/royal-alliance-associates-adds-350-million-key-group-management-to-expanding-advisor-network-300527435.html); keygroupwealth.com

Patrick Brian Murray.bio_note: President and CCO, co-founded Key Group in 1996. Graduate of Villanova University; holds CFP and ChFC (American College) designations. Career began in 1984 on the floor of the American Stock Exchange with E.F. Hutton, later working the fixed income trading desk for PaineWebber in New York and Los Angeles, before moving into financial advising in 1996.
Patrick Brian Murray.bio_source: U.S. News financial advisor profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/patrick-murray-1385990), corroborated by PR Newswire release on Royal Alliance/Key Group

Colin Patrick Heafy.bio_note: Vice President and Principal, co-founded Key Group in 1996 alongside Patrick Murray. Economics degree from Villanova University; serves on Villanova's College of Professional Studies Dean's Advisory Council. Career began at PaineWebber in 1990 as a Managed Account Liaison in Weehawken, NJ, rising to Investment Executive by 1992 and later Assistant VP of Investments; earlier stints at the NYSE, Dean Witter Reynolds, and Drexel Burnham Lambert. Holds FINRA Series 7, 24, 53, and 65.
Colin Patrick Heafy.bio_source: keygroupwealth.com team bio page, corroborated by PR Newswire release on Royal Alliance/Key Group (prnewswire.com/news-releases/royal-alliance-associates-adds-350-million-key-group-management-to-expanding-advisor-network-300527435.html)

firm_note.text: Ridgeline Private Wealth is a Mesa, AZ RIA operating as a nationwide virtual/location-independent advisory focused on business owners, specializing in tax reduction and investment strategy.

Caleb Will Huftalin.bio_note: Founder and Director of Wealth Management, CFP. Graduate of Northern Illinois University College of Business. Prior to founding Ridgeline (initially in 2019, refounded/restructured in 2021-2022), worked as a Wealth Advisor (CFP) at Catalyst Wealth Management from 2011 to 2019. Based in the far East Valley near the Superstition Mountains; husband and father of four boys.

Stephen Daniel Hofmann.bio_note: Co-Owner/Managing Member and Director of Wealth Planning, holding JD, CPA, CFP, and PPC credentials — a rare combination of law, accounting, and financial planning expertise. Bachelor's in accountancy from Northern Illinois University; J.D. from Thomas M. Cooley Law School (2010-2012); licensed Illinois attorney and CPA. Previously worked at Baker Tilly Virchow Krause and Midland Wealth Management, with 12+ years in the investment and financial industry. Based in Northern Illinois, not Arizona (worth noting — Ridgeline operates virtually/nationwide); married father of four.
Stephen Daniel Hofmann.bio_source: LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/steve-hofmann), corroborated by AdvisorCheck regulatory profile (advisorcheck.com/advisor/6994818-stephen-daniel-hofmann-ridgeline-private-wealth-rockford-illinois) and Midland States Bank bio (midlandsb.com/node/3501)

firm_note.text: Exeter Financial, LLC operates under the corporate umbrella of Alkeme Insurance (a national insurance/wealth management aggregator platform founded 2020). Exeter is listed as a partner firm on Alkeme's own website, and its cached SEC brochure references the Alkeme entity name, while its public-facing website still brands independently as Exeter Financial. Curtis Barton, Anton Rosandic, and Boris Michael Gutin hold their ownership/officer roles at the Alkeme corporate parent level (not as local Scottsdale team members); Stephen Harrison and Peter Helms are the actual local Managing Partners/co-founders running the Scottsdale practice.
firm_note.source: alkemeins.com/partners/exeter-financial/ (Alkeme's own partner listing for Exeter Financial, corroborating the parent/platform relationship)

Curtis Barton.bio_note: Corporate parent-level role, not a local Exeter/Scottsdale position. Curtis Barton is Co-Founder and CEO of ALKEME Insurance, the national insurance brokerage platform under which Exeter Financial's parent entity (Alkeme Intermediary Holdings LLC) sits. Over two decades of insurance industry experience, previously Founder and Chairman of Venture Pacific Insurance Services. Built ALKEME from a seven-agency collaboration in 2020 into a brokerage generating $350M+ in revenue across 35+ states via 85+ acquisitions. Holds a BA from the University of Arizona.
Curtis Barton.bio_source: InsurTech.ME interview (insurtech.me/insurtechtalks/2026/6/22/curtis-barton-ceo-of-alkeme) and ALKEME's own announcement (alkemeins.com/blog/alkeme-hires-industry-veteran-curtis-barton-as-chief-executive-officer); corroborated via Crunchbase profile

Anton Rosandic.bio_note: Corporate parent-level role, not local to Exeter's Scottsdale office. Anton Rosandic is a Co-Founder of ALKEME Insurance and currently serves as President of ALKEME. Originally joined as COO and was promoted to the newly created President role in April 2024, overseeing corporate support functions, growth, finance, HR, business operations, and talent management across the platform, which has completed 40+ acquisitions since its 2020 founding.
Anton Rosandic.bio_source: ALKEME press release distributed via Yahoo Finance (finance.yahoo.com/news/alkeme-announces-promotion-anton-rosandic-131500044.html) and Newswire

Boris Michael Gutin.bio_note: Corporate parent/investor-level role, entirely unconnected to Exeter's local Scottsdale operations. Boris Michael Gutin's Exeter filing role (President of Alkeme Holdings LLC) reflects a private-equity/investor-side capacity: he is Co-Managing Partner of GCP Capital Partners, the private equity firm that has backed ALKEME's growth, including leading a 2025 continuation vehicle transaction alongside Apollo S3. Has worked with the ALKEME team for over five years.

Stephen Leon Harrison.bio_note: Managing Partner, co-founder, and Chief Compliance Officer of Exeter Financial in Scottsdale — the actual local firm leader, with the firm since 2007. Leads a team serving high-net-worth individuals, families, and related entities with integrated wealth management. Before co-founding Exeter, was Managing Director, Private Wealth Management at Friedman, Billings, Ramsey (FBR); prior to that, Senior VP at Bank of America's Private Bank and VP at Northern Trust — nearly 30 years in the industry. Holds a business degree from the University of Washington and the CIMA designation plus Series 65 and life/health insurance licenses.
Stephen Leon Harrison.bio_source: LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/efsteveharrison/) independently listing him as Managing Partner at Exeter Financial, corroborating the firm's own bio page; also appears on AdvisoRanx advisor directory

Peter Helms.bio_note: Managing Partner and co-founder of Exeter Financial, part of the local Scottsdale leadership team (no CRD ownership stake on file, consistent with an operating partner rather than equity owner). Like his co-founder, came from Friedman, Billings, Ramsey (FBR) as Managing Director, Private Wealth Management; earlier was Senior VP at Bank of America's Private Bank and a Private Wealth Advisor at Merrill Lynch. Holds both a bachelor's degree and an MBA from the University of Arizona, and carries the CIMA designation plus Series 66 licensing.
Peter Helms.bio_source: U.S. News & World Report financial advisor profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/peter-helms-3048228), corroborated by his LinkedIn profile

firm_note.text: No parent-company complexity identified for Zenith Wealth Advisors. Note: both Thompson and Warnhoff have since moved primary roles to an affiliated entity, Zenith Private Bank & Trust, per independent sources — worth being aware of for outreach timing/accuracy, though Zenith Wealth Advisors remains their registered RIA per CRD.
firm_note.source: RocketReach and The Org listings for Daniel Thompson (theorg.com/org/zenith-private-bank-trust/org-chart/daniel-thompson) and ZoomInfo listing for Jenifer Warnhoff

Daniel Christopher Thompson.bio_note: President and CEO of Zenith Wealth Advisors (and its affiliated Zenith Private Bank & Trust) in Scottsdale, with the firm since 2022. A CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER with roughly a decade in the industry. Before founding/joining Zenith, spent about 14-17 years at First Western Trust Bank and First Western Investment Management, rising to Regional President at First Western Trust. Studied Finance at the University of Arizona and earned his CFP through the College for Financial Planning. Has also served as a board member for the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Scottsdale.
Daniel Christopher Thompson.bio_source: SmartAdvisorMatch advisor profile (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/daniel-thompson-2656870), corroborated by LinkedIn profile

Jenifer Warnhoff.bio_note: Served as Chief Compliance Officer and Relationship Manager at Zenith Wealth Advisors (with the firm since 2022) and has since moved into a VP, Deposit Operations / BSA & AML Officer role at the affiliated Zenith Private Bank & Trust. Before Zenith, held positions at First Western Trust, Wells Fargo, BBVA USA, and Chase, giving her a substantial banking-compliance background. Holds a Bachelor of Arts from Arizona State University.
Jenifer Warnhoff.bio_source: RocketReach professional profile and ZoomInfo listing, corroborating her career history across multiple institutions

firm_note.text: No parent-company or naming complexity identified for Taurum Retirement Partners.
firm_note.source: Taurum's own website plus independent LinkedIn corroboration

Robert Verlin Sollis.bio_note: Principal and Founder of Taurum Retirement Partners in Mesa, with the firm since 2015. Over 25 years of financial industry experience, including 13 years at Fidelity Investments as an Account Executive, where he was recognized with Fidelity's President's Circle Award and served on the Fidelity Customer Hero Advisory Council. In 2012 founded his own firm, Allay Financial Services, later folded into Taurum in 2016. Holds the ChFC designation from the American College of Financial Planning. Lives in Mesa with his wife and six children.
Robert Verlin Sollis.bio_source: LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/robsollis/), independently corroborating his ChFC credential and Principal title as stated on the firm's own site

firm_note.text: No parent-company or naming complexity identified for Profocus Incorporated.
firm_note.source: ProFocus's own website plus independent directory corroboration

Michael Maurice Smith.bio_note: Founder and CEO of ProFocus Incorporated in Phoenix, with the firm since 1998. Began his financial management career in 1981 at one of the top retirement/401(k) providers in the U.S., building customized retirement strategies for medical professionals and high-net-worth clients before founding ProFocus. Holds a CFP certification and a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, and is an honorably discharged veteran of the U.S. Air Force. Outside the firm, has been active in real estate development and formerly served as Treasurer of the Phoenix Industrial Development Authority (IDA) Board.
Michael Maurice Smith.bio_source: Independent advisor directory listings on SmartAdvisorMatch (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/michael-smith-1189477) and Unbiased.com, corroborating his CFP credential and founder role beyond the firm's own site

firm_note.text: Eaton-Cambridge Inc. is a Phoenix, AZ RIA offering combined wealth management, tax, and estate planning; it operates alongside an affiliated CPA practice (Eaton-Cambridge CPA PC), reflecting founder Robert Korljan's tax-partner background.
firm_note.source: eatoncambridge.com/people (firm site) corroborated by FinTrx firm profile

Marc T Giannone.bio_note: President of Eaton-Cambridge, leading firm strategy after joining in 2012 and now serving as Chief Compliance Officer and majority partner. A Messiah College graduate who previously worked as a Financial Planning Consultant at Merrill, drawing on an investment banking background, and holds the Retirement Income Certified Professional (RICP) designation from the American College. Outside the firm, serves as a board member of the National Christian Foundation Southwest and volunteers with Young Life.
Marc T Giannone.bio_source: LinkedIn profile, corroborating firm bio at eatoncambridge.com/team/marc-giannone

Robert Ralph Korljan.bio_note: Founded Eaton-Cambridge and has roughly 48 years in financial services. Before founding the firm, was a tax partner at BKD, LLP (now FORVIS), one of the largest CPA and advisory firms in the U.S. AICPA board-certified as a Personal Financial Specialist (CPA/PFS); graduate of both Arizona State University and Covenant Theological Seminary. With the firm since 1999 (26+ years tenure).
Robert Ralph Korljan.bio_source: SmartAdvisorMatch advisor profile (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/robert-korljan-2313014), corroborating firm bio at eatoncambridge.com/robert-bob-korljan

Shawna Stapleton.bio_note: CPA who joined Eaton-Cambridge in August 2019 and became a tax partner in 2020. An Arizona State University graduate and lifelong Arizona resident, specializes in small business, nonprofit, entity-selection, and complex individual tax work.
Shawna Stapleton.bio_source: TaxBuzz CPA directory listing (taxbuzz.com/find-the-best-cpa/arizona/phoenix/shawna-stapleton), corroborating firm bio at eatoncambridge.com/shawna-stapleton

Nathan Bergstrom.bio_note: Joined Eaton-Cambridge (outside sources place his hire around 2021). Graduated from the University of Phoenix in 2012 with a degree in Business Management and Entrepreneurship, and previously worked at Johnson Wealth Management, Financial Engines Advisors, Charles Schwab, and Quicken Loans before moving into financial planning. Active in his church's diaconate in downtown Phoenix.
Nathan Bergstrom.bio_source: SEC IAPD adviser summary (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/7078649), corroborating firm bio at eatoncambridge.com/nathan-bergstrom

firm_note.text: CorePath Wealth Partners (Scottsdale, AZ) is owned by CorePath Holdings LLC, which is itself wholly owned by Bonnett Investment Group LLC — the Phase 2 ownership flag is resolved: Mark A. Bonnett is confirmed as the sole owner of Bonnett Investment Group LLC and thus the controlling human behind CorePath Holdings LLC.
firm_note.source: Arizona business filing aggregator Bizapedia (bizapedia.com/az/corepath-holdings-llc.html) and BizProfile, independent of the firm's own website

Mark Alan Bonnett.bio_note: Founder and President of CorePath Wealth Partners (also referred to as CEO & Partner on the firm's team page) and, per Arizona business filings, the sole owner of Bonnett Investment Group LLC, which in turn wholly owns CorePath Holdings LLC — the entity that owns 75%+ of the firm. University of Arizona finance graduate who spent over two decades building his expertise in personal finance; prior to CorePath was Senior Vice President at North Star Resource Group. With the firm since 2004 (21+ years). Lives in Scottsdale with his wife Shawna and two daughters.
Mark Alan Bonnett.bio_source: Arizona business filings via Bizapedia/BizProfile (independent of firm website) confirming Bonnett Investment Group LLC ownership of CorePath Holdings LLC; career background corroborated by LinkedIn profile

Jacqueline Marie Battista.bio_note: Chief Operating Officer, Chief Compliance Officer & Partner at CorePath Wealth Partners, a role held since January 2019. Before CorePath, was a Financial Advisor at Ameriprise Financial. Holds an MBA in Finance from the University of Denver's Daniels College of Business and a BS in Business Administration from the University of Colorado, Boulder. Specialties include divorce financial planning, retirement, and estate planning.
Jacqueline Marie Battista.bio_source: LinkedIn profile, corroborating firm bio at corepathwealth.com/jacqueline-battista-cfp-cdfa-apma-mba

Rick Schultenover.bio_note: IMPORTANT FLAG FOR OUTREACH: appears to have LEFT CorePath Wealth Partners. Per an independent Financial Advisor Magazine article, he and a colleague received SEC approval to launch a new RIA, Salus Financial Partners/Advisors, headquartered in Colorado Springs with a second office in Minneapolis; he is now listed as a financial advisor at Salus Financial Advisors (Colorado Springs, CO) rather than CorePath. Previously worked at Securian Financial Services and CRI Securities in Denver. This appears to be a recent departure — verify current employment before outreach; he may no longer be a CorePath contact at all.
Rick Schultenover.bio_source: Financial Advisor Magazine, 'Two Advisors Start RIA In Colorado' (fa-mag.com/news/arizona-ria-with--274m-aum-splits-in-two-77252.html), an independent industry publication; corroborated by Salus Financial Advisors' own site and SEC IAPD

firm_note.text: Brightscape Investment Centers (Scottsdale, AZ office) was founded in 1999 by Eric Weiss; the Scottsdale/Arizona office was opened in 2020 specifically to be led by Amanda Wray, per an independent press release.

Eric Joshua Weiss.bio_note: Founder and CEO of Brightscape Investment Centers, established in 1999. Holds an MBA in Finance from the University of Chicago, where he interned at the Center for Research in Security Prices under Nobel laureate Myron Scholes, and an MA in Economics from Columbia University, completing his thesis under Nobel laureate Robert Mundell. Before founding Brightscape, directed business development for J.P. Morgan Chase's Global Asset Management and Private Bank division in northern Latin America and held a senior executive role in Citicorp's corporate finance operations in New York and Latin America. Named one of 'America's Top Financial Planners' by the Consumer's Research Council of America; member of NAPFA; authored the book 'Becoming Financially Literate: The Basics You Never Learned in High School.'
Eric Joshua Weiss.bio_source: PR Newswire press release announcing Brightscape's Scottsdale expansion (independent of firm website), corroborating firm bio at brightscape.com/ericweiss; book also independently listed on Amazon

Amanda Marie Wray.bio_note: Joined Brightscape in 2020 specifically to open and lead its new Scottsdale, AZ office — announced via a national press release — and now serves as President and Chief Compliance Officer. A fifth-generation Texan with a BBA in Management/Entrepreneurial Studies from the University of Texas, spent a decade in corporate marketing at Verizon and The Dallas Morning News before launching her own insurance and risk-planning practice, which evolved into comprehensive financial planning with a behavioral-finance specialty. Active in Fountain Hills and Scottsdale community volunteering; competes in pickleball.
Amanda Marie Wray.bio_source: PR Newswire press release, 'Brightscape Investment Centers Opens an Office in Scottsdale, AZ,' independent of the firm's own website
